subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Land Rover engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N63 across its Land Rover applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N63 appears in two Land Rover models — the Range Rover (L460) and Range Rover Sport (L461) — both as the P530 variant.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, valve seals, coolant system components, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with 48V MHEV components additionally accounted for.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Fuel injector failures are documented on this engine. Check engine light after hot restart and longer cranking time can indicate air in the cooling system. The hot-vee design means turbochargers sit inside the V of the engine, which is a genuine platform characteristic that adds complexity to accessing certain components — a consideration we account for when carrying out any rebuild work on this engine.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed N63 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: LAND ROVER N63 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The N63's hot-vee design — where the turbochargers sit inside the V of the engine — adds complexity to accessing certain components. This is a genuine platform characteristic we account for when quoting and carrying out any rebuild work on this engine in either Land Rover application. A full rebuild includes timing chain replacement, valve seals, coolant system components, and careful reassembly of the 48V mild-hybrid ancillaries, which are present across all N63 applications in the Land Rover range.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain assembly, bearings, valve seals, coolant system components, gaskets, 48V MHEV system components
